checks.name: Every exterior selection contains finite independently owned geometry
Vehicle and Body explorer share every revised skin and exterior part
Painted panel width retains the documented 1752 mm body envelope
Fuel door and intake occupy real openings in the driver quarter skin
Fuel cap and grip fit behind the closed fuel door
Both wheel openings have smooth circular lips and inward returns
Mirror glasses stay recessed in their shells, outside door glass
Front pads and fascia leave the park/turn apertures open
Curved bumper pad faces retain dense tessellation after wrapping
Wiper blade spans follow the nominal 18-inch envelope
Exterior service pieces have distinct explosion offsets
Roof glass and deck alternatives retain separate identities and option flags
Sunroof panel hardware follows the glass; body hardware survives removal
Sunroof trim, seal and latch housing leave their physical openings clear
Sunroof glass has separated upper and lower surfaces and independent hardware

limits: Actual reconstructed mesh checks; not measured factory tooling, crash structure, calibrated mechanism motion or owner acceptance.
